package main

// #include "utils.h"
import "C"

import (
	"context"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/cgo"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/adbc-drivers/driverbase-go/driverbase"
	"github.com/apache/arrow-adbc/go/adbc"
	"github.com/apache/arrow-go/v18/arrow"
	"github.com/apache/arrow-go/v18/arrow/array"
	"github.com/apache/arrow-go/v18/arrow/memory"
)

type closingDatabase struct {
	driverbase.Database
	close func()
}

func (d *closingDatabase) Close(context.Context) error { d.close(); return nil }

type closingConnection struct {
	driverbase.Connection
	close func()
}

func (c *closingConnection) Close(context.Context) error {
	c.close()
	return adbc.Error{Code: adbc.StatusIO}
}

type closingStatement struct {
	adbc.StatementWithContext
	close func()
}

func (s *closingStatement) Close(context.Context) error {
	s.close()
	return adbc.Error{Code: adbc.StatusIO}
}

type closingReader struct {
	array.RecordReader
	close func()
}

func (r *closingReader) Release() { r.close(); r.RecordReader.Release() }

func assertDeleted(t *testing.T, h cgo.Handle) {
	t.Helper()
	defer func() {
		if recover() == nil {
			t.Error("registry entry survived release")
		}
	}()
	h.Value()
}

func checkBridge(t *testing.T) {
	var err C.struct_AdbcError
	defer C.TesterrRelease(&err)
	h := cgo.NewHandle(&cDatabase{})
	db := C.struct_AdbcDatabase{private_data: createHandle(h)}
	owner := getFromHandle[cDatabase](db.private_data)
	calls := 0
	owner.db = &closingDatabase{close: func() {
		calls++
		if db.private_data != nil {
			t.Error("database owner still public during cleanup")
		}
		if code := TestDatabaseRelease(&db, nil); code != C.ADBC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE {
			t.Errorf("repeat database release: %d", code)
		}
	}}
	runtime.GC()
	if code := TestDatabaseRelease(&db, &err); code != C.ADBC_STATUS_OK {
		t.Fatalf("database release: %d", code)
	}
	assertDeleted(t, h)
	if calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("database close calls: %d", calls)
	}

	h = cgo.NewHandle(&cConn{})
	conn := C.struct_AdbcConnection{private_data: createHandle(h)}
	getFromHandle[cConn](conn.private_data).cnxn = &closingConnection{close: func() {
		if conn.private_data != nil {
			t.Error("connection owner still public during cleanup")
		}
	}}
	if code := TestConnectionRelease(&conn, &err); code != C.ADBC_STATUS_IO {
		t.Fatalf("connection error release: %d", code)
	}
	assertDeleted(t, h)
	if code := TestConnectionRelease(&conn, &err); code != C.ADBC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE {
		t.Fatalf("repeat connection release: %d", code)
	}

	h = cgo.NewHandle(&cStmt{})
	stmt := C.struct_AdbcStatement{private_data: createHandle(h)}
	getFromHandle[cStmt](stmt.private_data).stmt = &closingStatement{close: func() {
		if stmt.private_data != nil {
			t.Error("statement owner still public during cleanup")
		}
	}}
	if code := TestStatementRelease(&stmt, &err); code != C.ADBC_STATUS_IO {
		t.Fatalf("statement error release: %d", code)
	}
	assertDeleted(t, h)
	if code := TestStatementRelease(&stmt, &err); code != C.ADBC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE {
		t.Fatalf("repeat statement release: %d", code)
	}

	mem := memory.NewCheckedAllocator(memory.DefaultAllocator)
	defer mem.AssertSize(t, 0)
	builder := array.NewInt64Builder(mem)
	builder.AppendValues([]int64{101, 202}, nil)
	values := builder.NewArray()
	builder.Release()
	batch := array.NewRecordBatch(arrow.NewSchema([]arrow.Field{{Name: "x", Type: arrow.PrimitiveTypes.Int64}}, nil), []arrow.Array{values}, 2)
	values.Release()
	reader, e := array.NewRecordReader(batch.Schema(), []arrow.RecordBatch{batch})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	batch.Release()
	var stream C.struct_ArrowArrayStream
	released := 0
	exportRecordReader(&closingReader{RecordReader: reader, close: func() {
		released++
		if stream.private_data != nil || stream.release != nil {
			t.Error("stream owner still public during cleanup")
		}
		TestArrayStreamRelease(&stream)
	}}, &stream)
	reader.Release() // exportRecordReader retained its own reference.
	streamHandle := handleFromPtr(stream.private_data)
	if !reader.Next() {
		t.Fatal("missing retained batch")
	}
	retained := reader.RecordBatch()
	retained.Retain()
	TestArrayStreamRelease(&stream)
	TestArrayStreamRelease(&stream)
	assertDeleted(t, streamHandle)
	if released != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("reader release calls: %d", released)
	}
	if got := retained.Column(0).(*array.Int64).Value(1); got != 202 {
		t.Fatalf("retained batch value: %d", got)
	}
	retained.Release()

	var workers sync.WaitGroup
	for worker := 0; worker < 8; worker++ {
		workers.Go(func() {
			for i := 0; i < 64; i++ {
				value := new(int)
				ptr := createHandle(cgo.NewHandle(value))
				if getFromHandle[int](ptr) != value {
					t.Error("independent handle alias")
				}
				// Same ownership helper used by all four release paths.
				if takeHandle(ptr) != value {
					t.Error("lost owner")
				}
			}
		})
	}
	workers.Wait()
}
